_comment: A mutant is a small deliberate break in the SOURCE (>= becomes >, and becomes
or, a constant is bumped). A mutant that SURVIVES is a behaviour change no test
RATCHET: live score must be >= baseline_score. Raising a baseline is a normal
commit. LOWERING one is a deliberate act that must be justified in the PR --
which is the whole point, since a weakened assertion is otherwise invisible in
a diff and completely invisible to line coverage.
Targets are the small modules that decide what can merge. Mutating all of
dashboard.py would take hours and gate nothing; these run in seconds and gate
Baselines below were measured, not guessed. Re-measure with:

targets.why: IS the merge gate. A weakened gate lets every other guard through red.
Decides whether declared coverage is real. If it stops catching drift, the matrix becomes decoration.
